truncate table stg.csi_Customer;

With ADDR As
(Select 
	row_number() over (partition by site_ref ,cust_num order by VariationNumber desc) rn
	,cust_num
	,Name
	,cust_seq
	,CAST(RecordDate as date) RecordDate
	,site_ref
	,country
From raw.csi_custaddr_mst
where 
cust_seq = 0 )
,cust as
(select
	ROW_NUMBER() over (partition by site_ref, cust_num order by VariationNumber desc) rn
	,cust_num
	,site_ref
	,cust_type
	,stat
	,uf_sf_customer_type
	,uf_sf_accountid
from raw.csi_customer_mst
where cust_seq = 0)
INSERT INTO stg.csi_Customer
           (cust_num
           ,name
           ,country
           ,cust_type
           ,stat
           ,uf_sf_customer_type
           ,uf_sf_accountid
           ,site_ref)
Select 
	ADDR.cust_num
	,ADDR.name
	,ADDR.country
	,cust.cust_type
	,cust.stat
	,cust.uf_sf_customer_type
	,cust.uf_sf_accountid
	,ADDR.site_ref
From ADDR
inner join cust on 
	ADDR.site_ref = cust.site_ref and
	ADDR.cust_num = cust.cust_num
Where ADDR.rn = 1 and cust.rn = 1 ;

delete from temp_DimCustomer;

insert into temp_DimCustomer
(
	CustomerNumber
	,CustomerName
	,Country
	,CountryCode
	,CustomerType
	,CustomerStatus
	,SFCustomerType
	,Site
	,cus_h_key
)
SELECT 
	cust_num
	,name
	,country
	,'CA'
	,cust_type
	,stat
	,uf_sf_customer_type
	,site_ref
	,HASHBYTES('SHA1', concat(cust_num,cust_type,site_ref)) cus_h_key
FROM stg.csi_Customer;

merge edw.Dim_Customer as tgt
	using (select CustomerNumber, CustomerName, Country, CountryCode, CustomerType, CustomerStatus, SFCustomerType, Site from temp_DimCustomer) as src
	on (tgt.CustomerNumber = src.CustomerNumber and
		tgt.Site = src.Site)
when matched then
	update
		set CustomerName = tgt.CustomerName
when not matched then
	insert (CustomerNumber, CustomerName, Country, CountryCode, CustomerType, CustomerStatus, SFCustomerType, Site)
	values (src.CustomerNumber, src.CustomerName, src.Country, src.CountryCode, src.CustomerType, src.CustomerStatus, src.SFCustomerType, src.Site);

delete from stg.csi_Item ;

With itmst as
(
	SELECT  
		VariationNumber
		,row_number() over (partition by site_ref,item order by VariationNumber desc) rn
		,4 as 'SourceSystemID'
		,site_ref
		,item
		,description
		,abc_code
		,supply_site
		,supply_whse
		,prod_type
		,p_m_t_code
		,product_code
		,stat -- Active / Obsolete / Slowmoving
		,Uf_hierachy_level1
		,Uf_hierachy_level2
		,Uf_hierachy_level3
		,Uf_hierachy_level4
		,Uf_item_header
		,CAST(RecordDate as datetime) RecordDate
		,DLDeleteIndicator
	FROM raw.csi_item_mst
)

           ,abc_code
           ,supply_site

           ,prod_type
           ,p_m_t_code
           ,product_code
           ,stat
           ,RecordDate
           ,DLDeleteIndicator
           ,Uf_hierachy_level1
           ,Uf_hierachy_level2
           ,Uf_hierachy_level3
           ,Uf_hierachy_level4
           ,Uf_item_header)

select 
	itmst.SourceSystemID
	,itmst.site_ref
	,itmst.item
	,itmst.description
	,itmst.abc_code
	,itmst.supply_site
	,itmst.supply_whse
	,itmst.prod_type
	,itmst.p_m_t_code
	,itmst.product_code
	,itmst.stat
	,itmst.RecordDate
	,itmst.DLDeleteIndicator
	,itmst.Uf_hierachy_level1
	,itmst.Uf_hierachy_level2
	,itmst.Uf_hierachy_level3
	,itmst.Uf_hierachy_level4
	,itmst.Uf_item_header
from itmst
where itmst.rn = 1;

delete from dbo.temp_DimItem ;

insert into temp_DimItem
(Site, Item, Description, ABC_Code, ProductType, PMT_Code, ProductCode, Stat, ItemHeader, ProductCategory, ProductSubCategory, ProductFamily, ProductName, RecordDate )
SELECT 
	site_ref
	,trim(item) item
	,description
	,abc_code
	,prod_type
	,p_m_t_code
	,product_code
	,stat
	,Uf_item_header
	,Uf_hierachy_level1
	,Uf_hierachy_level2
	,Uf_hierachy_level3
	,Uf_hierachy_level4
	,cast(RecordDate as date) RecordDate
FROM stg.csi_Item;

merge edw.Dim_Item as tgt
	using 
		(SELECT  Site
			  ,Item
			  ,Description
			  ,ABC_Code
			  ,ProductType
			  ,PMT_Code
			  ,ProductCode
			  ,Stat
			  ,ItemHeader
			  ,ProductCategory
			  ,ProductSubCategory
			  ,ProductFamily
			  ,ProductName
			  ,RecordDate
		  FROM temp_DimItem
		) as src
	on (tgt.Item = src.Item and tgt.Site = src.Site)
when matched then
	update
		set tgt.Description = src.Description,
		tgt.ABC_Code = src.ABC_Code,
		tgt.ProductType = src.ProductType,
		tgt.PMT_Code = src.PMT_Code,
		tgt.ProductCode = src.ProductCode,
		tgt.Stat = src.Stat,
		tgt.ItemHeader = src.ItemHeader,
		tgt.ProductCategory = src.ProductCategory,
		tgt.ProductSubCategory = src.ProductSubCategory,
		tgt.ProductFamily = src.ProductFamily,
		tgt.ProductName = src.ProductName,
		tgt.RecordDate = src.RecordDate
when not matched then
	insert (Site, Item, Description, ABC_Code, ProductType, PMT_Code, ProductCode, Stat, ItemHeader, ProductCategory, ProductSubCategory, ProductFamily, ProductName, RecordDate )
	values (src.Site, src.Item, src.Description, src.ABC_Code, src.ProductType, src.PMT_Code, src.ProductCode, src.Stat, src.ItemHeader, src.ProductCategory, src.ProductSubCategory, src.ProductFamily, src.ProductName, src.RecordDate);

TRUNCATE TABLE stg.csi_Vendor;

WITH ADDR AS (
    SELECT 
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY site_ref, vend_num ORDER BY VariationNumber DESC) AS rn,
        vend_num,
        Name,
        CAST(RecordDate AS DATE) AS RecordDate,
        site_ref,
        country
    FROM raw.csi_vendaddr_mst
),
VEND AS (
    SELECT 
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY site_ref, vend_num ORDER BY RecordDate DESC) AS rn,
        vend_num,
        vend_type,
        stat,
        site_ref
    FROM raw.csi_vendor_mst
)

INSERT INTO stg.csi_Vendor (
    vend_num,
    vend_name,
    country,
    vend_type,
    stat,
    site_ref
)
SELECT 
    ADDR.vend_num,
    ADDR.Name,
    ADDR.country,
    VEND.vend_type,
    VEND.stat,
    ADDR.site_ref
FROM ADDR
INNER JOIN VEND 
    ON ADDR.site_ref = VEND.site_ref 
    AND ADDR.vend_num = VEND.vend_num
WHERE ADDR.rn = 1 AND VEND.rn = 1;

truncate table stg.csi_customer_orders;

With OrderHeader as
	(SELECT 
		trim(oh.[co_num]) as co_num -- Order (Number)
		--,CAST(oh.[order_date] as datetime) AT TIME ZONE 'Central European Standard Time' as order_date2 -- Order Date
		,dateadd(HOUR,2, CAST(oh.[order_date] as datetime)) as order_date
		,CAST(oh.CreateDate as date) as CreateDate
		,oh.[cust_num] -- Customer
		,oh.[bill_to_country]
		,oh.bill_to_state
		,oh.bill_to_zip
		,oh.ship_to_country
		,oh.ship_to_state
		,oh.ship_to_zip
		,oh.[site_ref]
		,oh.[curr_code] -- Currency
		,oh.[exch_rate] -- Rate'
		,oh.[price] EstTotalPrice-- Price
		,oh.sales_tax + oh.sales_tax_2 + oh.sales_tax_t as Tax
		,oh.freight + oh.freight_t as Freight
		,oh.[slsman] -- Salesperson - External
		,oh.taken_by -- Taken by - internal
		,oh.[stat] OrderStatus-- order Status - Planned / Ordered / Complete / Stopped / History
		,oh.Uf_SF_Application [Application]
		,oh.invoiced
	FROM [raw].[csi_co_mst] oh
	Where 
	oh.type = 'R')
	,
	OrderDetail as
	(
		SELECT 
		trim(od.[co_num]) as co_num -- Order (Number)
		,od.co_line
		,od.item
		,od.price_conv
		,od.qty_ordered_conv
		,od.disc
		,od.stat ItemStatus
		,od.DLDeleteIndicator
		,CAST(od.RecordDate as date) As RecordDate
		,dateadd(HOUR,2, CAST(od.due_date as datetime)) As due_date
		,dateadd(HOUR,2, CAST(od.promise_date as datetime)) As promise_date
		,CAST(od.CreateDate as date) As CreateDate
		,od.site_ref
		,od.stat As OrderLineStatus
		FROM [raw].[csi_coitem_mst] od
	)
	INSERT INTO stg.csi_customer_orders
        (co_num
		,order_date
		,site_ref
		,bill_to_country
		,bill_to_state
		,bill_to_zip
		,ship_to_country
		,ship_to_state
		,ship_to_zip
		,OrderStatus
		,Tax
		,Freight
		,cust_num
		,Application
		,curr_code
		,slsman
		,taken_by
		,OrderCreateDate 
		,co_line
		,item
		,price_conv
		,qty_ordered_conv
		,disc
		,OrderLineStatus
		,DLDeleteIndicator
		,RecordDate
		,due_date
		,promise_date
		,OrderlineCreateDate
		,invoiced)
	Select 
		h.co_num
		,h.order_date
		,h.site_ref
		,h.bill_to_country
		,h.bill_to_state
		,h.bill_to_zip
		,h.ship_to_country
		,h.ship_to_state
		,h.ship_to_zip
		,h.OrderStatus
		,h.Tax
		,h.Freight
		,h.cust_num
		,h.Application
		,h.curr_code
		,h.slsman
		,h.taken_by
		,h.CreateDate As OrderCreateDate
		,d.co_line
		,d.item
		,d.price_conv
		,d.qty_ordered_conv
		,d.disc
		,d.ItemStatus
		,d.DLDeleteIndicator
		,d.RecordDate
		,d.due_date
		,d.promise_date
		,d.CreateDate As OrderlineCreateDate
		,h.invoiced
	From OrderHeader h
	inner join OrderDetail d on 
		h.co_num = d.co_num and
		h.site_ref = d.site_ref
	--where h.rn = 1 and d.rn = 1;

source.sqlReaderQuery:
SELECT  
	s.SourceSystemID
	,co_num
	,o.order_date
	,o.site_ref
	,o.bill_to_country
	,o.bill_to_state
	,o.bill_to_zip
	,o.ship_to_country
	,o.ship_to_state
	,o.ship_to_zip
	,o.OrderStatus
	,o.Tax
	,o.Freight
	,o.cust_num
	,c.CustomerID
	,o.Application
	,o.curr_code
	,o.slsman
	,o.taken_by
	,o.co_line
	,o.item
	,i.ItemID
	,o.price_conv
	,o.disc
	,o.qty_ordered_conv
	,o.OrderLineStatus
	,o.DLDeleteIndicator
	,o.due_date
	,o.promise_date
	,o.OrderCreateDate
	,o.OrderlineCreateDate
	,o.RecordDate
	,o.invoiced
	,case o.OrderLineStatus
	when 'C' then 1
	when 'F' then 1
	else 0
	end as Complete
	,(o.qty_ordered_conv * o.price_conv) * (1 - (disc/100)) As Amount
	,'Base' as OrderType
	,isnull(v.ApplicationCode,0) as ApplicationCode
	,bc.iso_country_code as BillToCountryCode
	,sc.iso_country_code as ShipToCountryCode
	
FROM stg.csi_customer_orders o
left join edw.Dim_SourceSystem s on o.site_ref = s.Site
left join edw.Dim_Customer c on o.cust_num = c.CustomerNumber and o.site_ref = c.Site
left join edw.Dim_Item i on o.item = i.Item and o.site_ref = i.Site
left join edw.Dim_Vertical v on o.Application = v.ApplicationName
left join stg.csi_Country bc on o.bill_to_country = bc.Country
left join stg.csi_Country sc on o.ship_to_country = sc.Country

truncate table stg.csi_invoices;

With invhdr As
	(SELECT  
		trim(inv_num) inv_num -- Invoice Number
		,site_ref -- Site reference
		,trim(co_num) co_num -- Customer Order 
		,trim(cust_num) cust_num -- Customer Number  
		,dateadd(HOUR,2, CAST(inv_date as datetime)) inv_date  -- Invoice Date
		,cust_po
		,ec_code
		,freight
		,curr_code
		,price
		,CAST(RecordDate as date) RecordDate
		,CAST(CreateDate as date) CreateDate
		,shipment_id
		,slsman
		,state
		,bill_type
		,DLDeleteIndicator
	FROM raw.csi_inv_hdr_mst )
	,invdtl AS
	(Select
		trim(inv_num) inv_num -- Invoice Number
		,site_ref -- Site reference
		,trim(co_num) co_num -- Customer Order 
		,co_line
		,CAST(RecordDate as date) RecordDate
		,CAST(CreateDate as date) CreateDate
		,cost
		,disc
		,item
		,price
		,qty_invoiced
		,DLDeleteIndicator
	FROM raw.csi_inv_item_mst
	)

	,h.price as total_price

SELECT 
	s.SourceSystemID
	,GETDATE() as ProcessDate
	,inv.cust_num
	,c.CustomerID
	,inv.site_ref
	,inv.inv_date
	,trim(inv.inv_num) inv_num
	,inv.co_num
	,inv.co_line
	,inv.item 
	,i.ItemID 
	,inv.qty_invoiced
	,inv.price
	,inv.RecordDate
	,inv.LineCreateDate
	,inv.curr_code
	,inv.disc
	,'Base' as OrderType
	,cast(inv.price as decimal(18,2)) as DocExtPrice	-- inv.price
	,cast(inv.disc as decimal(18,2)) as DocDiscount		-- inv.disc
	,cast(inv.price as decimal(18,2)) as ExtPrice		-- inv.price
	,cast(inv.disc as decimal(18,2)) as Discount		-- inv.disc
	,(inv.qty_invoiced * inv.price)  As Amount
	,isnull(DLDeleteIndicator,0) as VoidLine 
	,inv.bill_type
	,inv.total_price
FROM stg.csi_invoices inv
Left Join edw.Dim_Customer c on inv.cust_num = c.CustomerNumber and inv.site_ref = c.Site
Left Join edw.Dim_Item i on inv.item = i.item  and inv.site_ref = i.Site
left join edw.Dim_SourceSystem s on inv.site_ref = s.Site
where --inv.co_num in (select distinct OrderNumber from fact_Booking where OrderType = 'Base')
----and 
inv.bill_type in ('N','R','M','P')

SELECT  
	ss.SourceSystemID
	,getdate() ProcessDate
	,sro.sro_num
	,sro.line
	,sro.sro_line
	,case sro.stat_code 
		when '11 Shipped' Then 1
		Else 0

	,sro.cust_num

	,country.iso_country_code bill_to_country
	,country.iso_country_code CountryCode
	,sro.item
	,item.ItemID
	,sro.matl_qty
	,sro.extprice
	,sro.curr_code
	,sro.disc

	,cast(sro.open_date as date) open_date
	,sro.site_ref
	,sro.stat_code
	,app.ApplicationCode
	--,sro.ItemStatus
	,sro.DLDeleteIndicator
	,sro.type
	,sro.trans_type
	,sro.posted
	,cast(sro.TransRecordDate as date) as TransRecordDate
	,cast(sro.TransCreateDate as date) as TransCreateDate
	,cast(sro.due_date as date) due_date
	,cast(sro.crd as date) as crd
	,sro.slsman
	,sro.partner_id
	,'Service' OrderType
	,sro.inv_num
	,sro.inv_line
	,sro.freight_t
	,(sro.total_sales_tax1 + sro.total_sales_tax2) as sales_tax_t
FROM stg.[csi_service_orders] sro
